description: Multiplex network agent-based simulation of mask-wearing behavior with endogenous information diffusion and government intervention. Calibrated on days 0–29; predicts days 30–39.

behaviors.name: update_info_state
behaviors.description: Agents receive information from exogenous broadcast and from informed neighbors via independent cascade on each layer.
behaviors.algorithm: For day t: if training and t <= 29 and use_observed_info_during_training, set received_info_today from train_data. Else: 1) Exogenous info: Bernoulli(lambda_t) where lambda_t = lambda_external_base * (lambda_multiplier if t >= intervention_day else 1). 2) Peer info: For each layer L, compute probability of receiving info from informed neighbors: p_peer_L = 1 - Π_{k in neighbors_L with info}(1 - tau_L). Optionally scale tau_L by interaction_rates[L]. Agent is informed today if Bernoulli(1 - (1 - p_exog) * Π_L (1 - p_peer_L)) = 1. Set received_info_yesterday = received_info_today at end of day.

behaviors.name: compute_peer_exposure
behaviors.description: Compute weighted share of masked neighbors across layers.
behaviors.algorithm: For each layer L in {family, work_school, community}, compute masked_share_L = (# masked neighbors in L) / max(1, degree_L). Exposure E = Σ_L w_L * masked_share_L. If t >= intervention_day, optionally multiply w_L by peer_weight_multiplier.

behaviors.name: adopt_mask
behaviors.description: Previously unmasked agents adopt based on info, peer exposure, risk, and baseline hazard.

parameters.alpha0: baseline intercept calibrated so that adoption without info and peers matches p_on_noinfo
parameters.beta_info: derived from transitions: log(OR_info) using p_on_info vs p_on_noinfo

behaviors.algorithm: If mask_state_{t-1} = 0: compute E via compute_peer_exposure. Let r = risk_perception - mean_risk. Compute logit p_on = alpha0 + beta_info * (received_info_today) + beta_peer * E + beta_risk * r. If t >= intervention_day, multiply beta_info by beta_info_multiplier. Adopt with Bernoulli(sigmoid(p_on)).

behaviors.name: drop_mask
behaviors.description: Previously masked agents may stop masking with probability p_drop (optionally reduced by info or peer exposure).
behaviors.algorithm: If mask_state_{t-1} = 1: compute p_off = p_drop_base * (p_drop_multiplier if t >= intervention_day else 1). Optionally set p_off = p_off * exp(-eta_info * received_info_today - eta_peer * E). Drop with Bernoulli(p_off).

behaviors.name: broadcast_guidance
behaviors.description: Government modifies information environment and behavioral responsiveness starting on intervention_day.
behaviors.algorithm: For t >= intervention_day, set global multipliers for lambda_external, layer_weights, beta_info, and p_drop applied in the respective behaviors.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: Neighbor mask states increase adoption hazard for unmasked agents via weighted exposure.
interactions.effect: Increase in log-odds of adoption proportional to beta_peer * exposure.

interactions.name: InfoTransmission
interactions.description: Informed agents transmit information to neighbors with per-layer probabilities.
interactions.effect: Receiver’s received_info_today toggled with probability derived from tau_L and number of informed neighbors.

interactions.name: GovernmentBroadcast
interactions.description: Exogenous increase in information and/or adherence after intervention.
interactions.effect: Adjust global multipliers affecting info arrival rate, peer weight, and drop probability.

initialization.data_alignment: restrict to intersection of agent_ids across all files
initialization.mask_state_at_day0: from train_data day 0 if available else agent_attributes.initial_mask_wearing
initialization.network_build: load social_network.json; validate all equals union of layers; apply symmetrize_mode

algorithms.daily_scheduler: Synchronous update per day: 1) Government broadcast multipliers (if t>=intervention_day). 2) Update info state for all agents (using observed info if training). 3) Compute peer exposure E for all agents. 4) Update mask states: adopt or drop. 5) Apply exogenous_noise_flip to randomly flip states with small probability. 6) Log outcomes.
algorithms.parameter_estimation_step1: Direct-from-data: compute p_on_noinfo, p_on_info, p_drop, lambda_external_base from train_data (days 0–29). Derive beta_info = log(OR_info).
algorithms.parameter_estimation_step2: Logistic regression on train_data (joined to attributes): logit(P(Mt=1 | Mt-1=0)) ~ received_info_t + risk + demographics to refine alpha0 and beta_risk; persistence handled via conditioning on Mt-1.
algorithms.simulation_calibration: Bayesian optimization or ABC-SMC over {beta_peer, tau_per_layer, layer_weights (bounded), beta_risk, exogenous_noise_flip} to minimize weighted objective: RMSE of prevalence + Peak Adoption Rate Error + Time-to-Peak Error on a validation slice within days 0–29.
algorithms.forecasting: Run model without observed received_info for days 30–39 using endogenous info dynamics and intervention multipliers.

data_sources.name: agent_attributes.csv
data_sources.purpose: Initialize agent demographics, risk, initial mask states (if train day 0 not used), and degree targets for QC.

data_sources.name: social_network.json
data_sources.purpose: Define multiplex adjacency lists (family, work_school, community) for influence and info transmission.

data_sources.name: train_data.csv
data_sources.purpose: Calibrate transition probabilities and info rates on days 0–29; validate prevalence trajectory; seed states on day 0.

files.name: config.yaml
files.description: Holds tunable parameters, intervention settings, symmetrization choice, and file paths.

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads CSV/JSON, aligns agent IDs, validates network layers, and constructs per-layer neighbor lists (directed/undirected).

files.name: network_utils.py
files.description: Computes degrees, clustering, reciprocity, and mixing matrices; provides exposure computation helpers.

files.name: model.py
files.description: Defines Agent and Government classes and the core Simulator with daily scheduler.

files.name: behaviors.py
files.description: Implements update_info_state, compute_peer_exposure, adopt_mask, drop_mask behaviors.

files.name: calibration.py
files.description: Estimates direct-from-data parameters; runs Bayesian optimization/ABC-SMC for peer and info transmission parameters.

files.name: evaluation.py
files.description: Computes RMSE, Peak Adoption Rate Error, Time-to-Peak Error; additional diagnostics.

files.name: run_train.py
files.description: Entry point for calibration and in-sample validation on days 0–29.

files.name: run_forecast.py
files.description: Runs the trained model to predict days 30–39 and outputs daily prevalence and agent-level states.

files.name: utils.py
files.description: Common utilities: random seeds, logging, reproducibility, parameter serialization.
